correctness.rationale: Kummer carry digit formula and the exact denominator normalization give a finite disjoint trailing-2 decomposition. The displayed transfer matrix is checked by all three digits in both carry states; formal inversion proves the exact rational generating function. Explicit digits realize exactly the triangular support, with counted unique top-carry patterns. Differentiation yields the exact covariance, and the dominant simple eigenvalue plus geometric tightness yields the joint CLT. An independent Legendre-factorial checker matches 29,523 indices and 800 direct binomial calculations. The infinite claims rely on algebraic proofs, not finite tests.

value.rationale: Complete joint distributions of canonical numerator/normalized Catalan numbers are meaningful beyond individual valuation frequencies: the result determines every mixed coefficient at every natural ternary block, a sharp triangular support and boundary, and an explicit covariance growing linearly rather than bounded as for a different binomial pair. This answers a natural dependence question arising from normalization, with a mechanistic carry proof and no arbitrary finite slicing.
